quarterly_data.signal: Pfizer (clinical collaborator and supplier): Relay's 10-Q states that in June 2024 it entered into a clinical trial collaboration with Pfizer to evaluate atirmociclib in combination with zovegalisib and fulvestrant in PI3Kα-mutated, HR+, HER2- metastatic breast cancer in its ReDiscover trial, and that in April 2026 it entered into a supply agreement under which Pfizer agreed to supply atirmociclib and palbociclib for the planned Phase 3 trial of zovegalisib with atirmociclib and an aromatase inhibitor, subject to regulatory feedback.
